    🙏 Shurtra¶

    "Mabode came from the stars to save humanity."

    Origins¶

    Shurtra was founded by Mabode — a philosopher king born on Erima island roughly 200 years before the founding of the Erisian church (~200 BGD-era). A philosopher king by trade, Mabode eventually turned conqueror. In his delusion of grandeur, he began collecting myths of ancient peoples who came from the stars — and then claimed he came from them too. The people believed him.

    The name Shurtra means "righteousness" in the Shurtraliot language — literally "righteous language".

    Shurtra is therefore roughly 200 years older than the Erisian Church.

    Beliefs¶

    • Mabode came from the stars to save humanity.
    • Mabode is a star-born savior, not a god of earth.
    • The faith demands extreme honor from its male followers — men are held to a standard of righteousness that few can sustain.

    Practices & Consequences¶

    • Honor culture: Shurtra men are highly expected to be extremely honorable. Failure is shame beyond measure (see Honor Culture).
    • Death cults: This impossible standard makes death cults common — followers who believe they cannot live up to the faith choose death instead. This in turn leads authorities to usually crack down on the cults (see Death Cults).
    • Language: Shurtraliot is commonly spoken in the Aenid Kingdom.

    Influence¶

    • Majority: Aenid Kingdom (founded here), Malbodor (Sandsmen), Astravayne, Augagarten
    • Aenid is situated in a desertic region — all of that area, including the island (Erima), is desert. Similarly, Augagarten is desertic, and Astravayne is a lot desertic too.

    Enmity with the Erisian Church¶

    Shurtra is a fierce enemy of the Erisian church. The Erisian Church conquered a lot of Shurtra's lands over the centuries — and the faith has never forgiven it. The star-born savior stands against the fabricated goddess Eris.

    Connections¶
